protocol.signal: daily SMA 8/40; bearish target -0.1x only when the latest known funding rate exceeds the selected threshold
protocol.causality: funding events at or before each 15m bar are used; no future rate
protocol.costs: 10 bps fee + 5 bps slippage; historical funding
protocol.hard_leverage: maximum observed open and intrabar-low futures leverage <=3x
protocol.selection: Research + Validation only; OOS and 2019 holdout excluded

limitations: The OOS period is historical and visible; it is not a fresh holdout.
The funding gate can change trade frequency and funding exposure materially.
A positive historical result still requires fresh forward observation.
